department.name: Department of Computer Application
department.college: SVIET - Swami Vivekanand Institute of Engineering & Technology
department.vision: To be a leading department in computer applications, fostering innovation, research excellence, and producing skilled professionals who contribute to technological advancement and societal development.
department.mission: To provide quality education in computer applications through innovative teaching methodologies, industry collaboration, and research activities while nurturing ethical values and leadership qualities in students.
department.history: Established in 2010, the Department of Computer Application has been at the forefront of computer education and research. With state-of-the-art laboratories and experienced faculty, we have successfully graduated over 1000 students who are now working in leading IT companies worldwide.

courses.name: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
courses.description: A comprehensive undergraduate program covering programming, software development, database management, and web technologies.

courses.name: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
courses.description: An advanced postgraduate program focusing on software development, system analysis, and emerging technologies.
